text:
Anna Chen: tiny review after playing with the new rules panel — ordering feels visually ambiguous when rules share priority. dragging an item, I can't tell exactly where it'll land.
Mike R: saw that. the drag handle overlaps the next item so hover state is confusing.
Sophia Patel: proposal: show a translucent "ghost" placeholder row where the rule will land + add a compact match-count pill in the left gutter so you can see pre/post impact while dragging :bulb:
Derek Li: agree. also the inline validation just says 'invalid rule' which doesn't help. need prescriptive text so users can take next steps
Anna Chen: suggested validation copy: "Rule conflict: multiple rules match the same request. Reorder to resolve, or narrow the rule conditions." shorter version for compact mode: "Conflict: multiple matches. Reorder or refine."
Jin (designbot): accessibility notes: announce "drag started" and "position X of Y" with aria-live. ensure reorder handles are keyboard-focusable and support arrow key move actions. provide visible focus ring and live region updates for non-pointer users
Mike R: example payload from validation service for engineers to hook into UI:
`{ "error": "conflict", "message": "2 rules match incoming request.", "affected_rules": ["r-73","r-74"] }`
Sophia Patel: simulator edge-case: after editing a rule the preview sometimes shows 0 matches even though sample inputs should match. feels like it's using the saved config not the draft. propose a "Run simulation (draft)" toggle and a small "results stale" banner when the draft differs from saved config
Derek Li: +1. also the Run button should show a spinner and be disabled while the simulator compiles the new set. add an input carousel so reviewers can step through sample requests and see which rule matched and why
Anna Chen: microcopy change: update button label from "Run sim" to "Run simulation (draft)" and set tooltip: "Use current unsaved edits for simulation". that'll reduce confusion
Mike R: i'm happy to PR the label change and add the match-count pill. will also prototype the ghost placeholder animation
Derek Li: i'll add the aria-live announcements and keyboard reorder semantics. will drop notes in the a11y doc
Sophia Patel: i'll rewrite the inline validation copy and draft a short playbook: "Resolving rule conflicts" with annotated screenshots and step-by-step reorder flow
Anna Chen: plan: Mike -> visuals + pill; Derek -> a11y hooks; Sophia -> copy & playbook. Demo tomorrow 10am. Thanks everyone :rocket:
